mapper.select: SELECT REPLACE( REPLACE(promptValue, '??????', b.userNm) , '######', b.tutorNm ) AS prompt FROM DOGPOO_AI_SYSTEM_PROMPT AS a INNER JOIN DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_USER AS b ON b.userId = #{userId} AND a.mode = b.mode WHERE a.mode = #{mode} AND a.promptNm = #{promptNm} AND a.useYn LIMIT 1

SELECT idx, input, output FROM (SELECT idx, input, output FROM DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_HISTORY WHERE userId = #{userId} AND mode = #{mode} AND LENGTH(input) > 0 AND LENGTH(output) > 0 ORDER BY idx DESC LIMIT ${memoryLimit}) AS a ORDER BY idx

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(number, '. ', content) SEPARATOR '\n') AS content FROM (SELECT row_number() over ( ORDER BY idx ) AS number, content, endSeq FROM DOGPOO_AI_CHATBOT_SUMMARY WHERE userId = #{userId} AND mode = #{mode} ORDER BY endSeq LIMIT ${summaryLimit}) AS a
